description: Live spot price for any COIN-USD pair from Coinbase. Provided by Money Reactor — x402 paid APIs (founding provider) through the naxytra open provider network; routed and settled by the xytara runtime. Price: $0.001 per call or 1 credit with a spend key; a single x402 payment for it is $0.005 (the per-payment settlement minimum); failed calls are not charged. Not covered by the free allowance.
